description: Normalises raw catalog JSON and builds the text used for BM25, semantic embeddings (EIS) and reranking

script.description: category label, review count and the combined product_text
script.source: String cat = ctx.category == null ? '' : ctx.category.replace('-', ' '); ctx.category_label = cat; ctx.review_count = ctx.reviews == null ? 0 : ctx.reviews.size(); String tags = ctx.tags == null ? '' : String.join(', ', ctx.tags); ctx.product_text = ctx.title + ' by ' + ctx.brand + '. Category: ' + cat + '. Tags: ' + tags + '. ' + ctx.description + ' Price: ' + ctx.price + ' USD. Rating: ' + ctx.rating + ' of 5. ' + (ctx.warranty_information == null ? '' : ctx.warranty_information + '.');
